(2) The scene transitions to a close-up of the man's hands as he grips the lantern and pulls the top section upwards, revealing a metallic telescoping neck that extends the device's height. His facial expression is focused as he looks down at the mechanical function. (3) A close-up shot follows, focusing on the base of the lantern. The man uses his fingers to rotate a gold-colored dial. As he turns it, the light inside the lantern shifts from a warm, dim orange glow to a bright, cool white light. (4) The camera shows a close-up of the side of the lantern where the man peels back a rubber protective cover to reveal a USB-C and USB-A charging port. His hands are the central focus as he points out the technical details. (5) The scene cuts to an outdoor night environment. The man is standing in a field of green grass, holding the lantern at waist height. The lantern illuminates a circular patch of grass beneath him. He raises and lowers the device to demonstrate the changing light spread. (6) In a final outdoor full shot, the man walks slowly across the grass, holding the lantern to show how it casts light on his legs and the surrounding ground. The lighting is high-contrast, with the lantern being the only significant light source against the dark background.
